Glucodynamic model for Lyumjev U100 (standard concentration); This model automatically adjusts the duration of insulin action (DIA).
Experimental Traffic Jam Glucodynamic model. Uses a unified 8-hour analytic depot pool to calculate dynamic Subcutaneous accumulation.

How many times faster or slower than standard insulin acts. Every stage, from the injection site to the active stage, speeds up or slows down by this factor. At 2, a 1 U dose\'s activity peaks after about 36 minutes instead of 71; at 0.5, after about 142 minutes.

How much boluses and SMBs still being absorbed slow each other down. At 1, each dose absorbs at the pace of all bolus insulin still at the injection site: 12 SMBs of 7.85 U in total over 160 minutes reach half their effect 47 minutes later than if each were alone. At 0.5: 32 minutes later; at 0.3: 23; at 0.1: 11; at 0, each dose absorbs as if it were alone. A dose given with no other bolus insulin on board is the same at every value.
